lines: Display name — Shown instead of your username on rosters and draws.
Time zone: This device's time zone | Europe/Kyiv | … — Session times show in this zone. cab keeps every time in UTC.
Played as a guest? Paste that session's personal link to move its results onto this account.
Personal link → Add to my account The link stops working once its history is yours.

Linking lets you sign in to this same account with either. Separate accounts are fine too: link only if you want them to be one. If the method you link already has its own cab account, you can merge the two.

blocks.text: An unlinked method reads "not linked" with link Google; the last method reads "your only sign-in" and cannot be removed. Linking a method that has its own account opens /account/merge.
